caption: The drawing consists of a decorative rectangular border composed of alternating green, blue, brown, and light pink geometric and floral patterns. Inside the border at the top is a row of uppercase English alphabet letters in black, followed by another row of uppercase letters with a cross-stitch pattern, and the text "SARAH PARK" in brown. Below this, there is a short poem written in two lines of black text, with the lines slightly uneven: "It is content of heart gives nature power to please the mind that feels no smart enlivens all it sees." Surrounding the text are small decorative objects: on the top left is a plant with pink flowers in a pot, on the middle right is a green leafy plant in a blue pot, and to the left of the plant is a pink flower on a stem. Below the text and to the left, there is a brown tree with light green leaves and numerous bright red fruit or flowers. Above the tree and across the middle section are three green birds with outstretched wings. On the lower right side is a white building with blue roofs, windows, and a door, consisting of a main structure with three stories and an adjacent one-story addition; behind the building are green trees and shrubs, and the ground is depicted in light blue and green. The entire image uses soft, muted tones including beige as the background, with accents in blue, green, pink, red, brown, and black.
title: Sampler
